info.title: JustRAG Public API
info.description:
API for interacting with JustRAG knowledge bases. Authenticate using API keys generated from your user profile.

## Authentication
All endpoints require a Bearer token (API key with `jrag_` prefix) in the `Authorization` header.

## Streaming
Chat endpoints support Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming by default. Set `?stream=false` to receive a synchronous JSON response instead.

### SSE Format
```
data: {"type": "...", ...}

data: [DONE]
```

tags.name: Open WebUI Compatible (ILIAS)
tags.description: Subset of Open WebUI's API for the ILIAS LfAssistant plugin's "Open WebUI RAG" mode; the plugin is the only intended client. Off unless the global site_config flag `owui_compat_enabled` is on (every route answers `404 {"detail"}` for an authenticated key while it is off). Rate limits count per API key: 600/min for chat, 300/min for every other route. Uploads are only stored; indexing starts when a file is added to a collection. Several error cases answer 2xx on purpose because the plugin throws on any status >= 400. Full contract: docs/api-contracts/owui-compat.md.

get.description: Lists all accessible knowledge bases as OpenAI-compatible models. Each knowledge base is exposed as a model with ID in the format `kb-<uuid>`.

post.description: Create a chat completion using a knowledge base as the backing model. Compatible with the OpenAI chat completions API. Only the last user message is used as the query; conversation history is not used for retrieval.

200.description: Chat completion response (sync) or SSE stream of chunks (when stream=true)

403.description: No access to this knowledge base

post.description: OpenAI-style chat request; `files: [{"type":"collection","id":<kbId>}]` selects the collection. Streams SSE: the first frame is Open WebUI's `{"sources":[{"source","document":[…],"metadata":[{"file_id",…}]}]}` (file_id = upload id, numbered like the answer's `[n]` markers), then OpenAI chunks and `[DONE]`. Honours `temperature` (streaming) and the reasoning knobs; `model`, `max_tokens` and `top_p` are ignored. A mid-stream error is a raw `{"detail"}` line.

200.description: Answer (SSE when `stream` is true, else a chat.completion object)

post.summary: Add an upload to a collection
post.description: Starts indexing the upload in the collection's KB (parse, chunk, embed, knowledge graph — or an index copy when another collection already indexed the same file). A soft failure (unknown upload, KB full, file gone) answers 200 **without `id`**, so the plugin retries in its next run.

post.description: Removes the file's KB copy and index (unless another upload id in the collection still maps to it); the library file stays. If the cleanup fails the answer is 500 and the link is kept.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key with `jrag_` prefix. Pass as `Authorization: Bearer jrag_...`

model.description: Knowledge base ID in format kb-<uuid>

annotations.description: Present on the final chunk (alongside finish_reason): offsets require the assembled answer.

context.description: Present on the first chunk (alongside the role delta): retrieval completes before the first token.

FileCitationAnnotation.description: Inline citation anchored to a [n] marker in the answer, following OpenAI's annotation shape.

index.description: Character (rune) offset of the citation marker within message.content. Not a byte offset.

RetrievedCitation.description: One retrieved chunk that fed the answer. Shaped like Azure OpenAI "On Your Data".

MessageContext.description: Retrieved chunk bodies. Omitted entirely when retrieval returned nothing.

ChatCompletionResponseMessage.description: Assistant message. Carries source attribution in addition to the standard OpenAI fields; both citation keys are omitted (never empty) when there is nothing to report.

annotations.description: One entry per [n] marker occurrence; a multi-cite marker yields one entry per source.

detail.description: German message, safe to show students

id.description: Upload id (fresh per upload, not the library file id)

status.description: `completed` once stored; `failed` only for an unknown id

Forbidden.description: No access to this knowledge base
